13 live WebGPU effects

Shader Gallery

One page per effect. Tweak every parameter in real time and copy the code. Powered by the open-source shaders package.

Textures Aurora Shimmering northern-light curtains with adjustable rays, waviness and palette. Textures Plasma Classic warped plasma, retuned for the GPU. Drag density and warp to taste. Textures Flowing Gradient Four colors blended in OKLCH that drift and fold into each other. Shape Effects Liquid Metal A rippling chrome surface with environment reflections and dispersion. Shape Effects Nebula Volumetric gas, dust and twinkling stars wrapped around a glowing core. Distortions Kaleidoscope A distortion that wraps any layer beneath it. Here it folds a flowing gradient. Stylize Glitch RGB splits, block tearing and scanlines applied to a live plasma feed. Stylize Halftone Print-style dots, in simple or CMYK mode, over a drifting gradient. Stylize Dither Seven dithering algorithms, from Bayer matrices to Floyd–Steinberg. Interactive Reaction Diffusion A living Turing-pattern simulation. Move the cursor over it to paint. Interactive Cursor Trail A gradient ribbon that follows your pointer, layered over a dark backdrop. Textures Voronoi Animated cellular patterns with soft or sharp borders. Textures Godrays Volumetric light shafts streaming in from a point you control.
Effects by Shaders (MIT). Needs a WebGPU-capable browser (recent Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox).
